regions.region: page 7 upper-left continuation of chiral methyl lamenallenate characterization
regions.finding: The text completes the page-6 1.16 mmol EATA experiment with full chiral-HPLC conditions, retention times, specific rotation, and spectroscopy. It enriches the existing scale-up record and is not a second preparation.

regions.region: page 7 left column racemic EATA reaction arrow and detailed paragraph
regions.finding: A distinct racemic control uses CuBr2, equal quantities of (S)-26 and (R)-26, alkyne 4 and aldehyde 3 in two dioxane portions at 130 °C for 12 h, followed by acid wash/chromatography, to give (rac)-(+-)-2 as 60.7 mg in 52% isolated yield.

regions.region: page 7 lower-left to upper-right hydrolysis arrow and cross-column paragraph
regions.finding: The existing Scheme 4 hydrolysis was enriched with exact KOH/substrate charges, two 2 mL MeOH/H2O portions, 60 °C/3 h, ice-bath HCl addition, full workup, chromatography, 109.3 mg/98% acid, E/Z 94/6, and specific rotation.

regions.region: page 7 right-center ee-determination methylation arrow and paragraph
regions.finding: The existing analytical re-methylation was enriched with exact acid, mixed-solvent and TMSCHN2-solution charges, cold dropwise addition, natural warming, 3 h elapsed completion time, chromatography, 56.2 mg/96%, E/Z 94/6, 97% ee, full HPLC conditions, and specific rotation.

regions.region: page 7 lower-right acknowledgments and beginning of references
regions.finding: Funding acknowledgments and bibliography only; no additional current-paper experiment or separable reproduced run is reported.
